top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is an original invention (the magic-wavelength condition for many neutral atoms) with a short, clear credit chain to Katori and Ye, independently reproduced and surpassed, and already yielding statements about nature (gravitational redshift, constants, dark-matter limits). The citation is narrow enough to stay distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. It is mature and verified, so an award is preferable to no award.
